الحسن بن علي بن أبي طالب

notes: «عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم» : «عمه» + a name is one link, written by the name alone (rule 7)
«عن آبائه» is a collective relation with no name, kept as relation; «عن جده الحسن بن علي بن أبي طالب» is one link written by its name
the Jew's words and the Prophet's answers inside the saying are not links; «عليهم السلام» is left out

notes: «عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم»: «عمه» + name is one link with the name alone (rule 7).
«عن آبائه» is a plural relation with no name: relation link.

«عن جده الحسن بن علي بن أبي طالب» (rule 7): the name alone; the Imam inside the chain after «عن» is a narrator (owner ruling 2). The long saying is the Imam's relation of the Prophet's words to the Jewish questioner.
